opinions.text: Ct. App. Ohio, Wood County. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pau-*1047peris denied. Petitioner is allowed until June 8, 1987, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33. of the Rules of this Court,

opinions.author: Brennanmarshallstevens
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, and Justice Stevens,

dissenting.

For the reasons expressed in Brown v. Herald Co., 464 U. S. 928 (1983), we would deny the petition for writ of certiorari without reaching the merits of the motion to proceed in forma pauperis.
